objective: Gate final de solo lectura para cerrar la regresion de Operaciones > Analisis en CIENFUEGOS. Verificar en EDARSAHUB SQL que existen inventarios fisicos canonicos de CIENFUEGOS, que sus almacenes tienen correspondencia codigo+nombre con dbo.Inventario_Almacenes y que existe una sucursal canonica con almacenes activos. Sin POS LIVE, Mongo, DDL, DML ni Produccion.

queries.name: cienfuegos_final_gate
queries.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(almacen_id)) AS almacen_id, UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(almacen))) AS almacen FROM dbo.Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync WHERE UPPER(unidad_negocio_codigo)='CIENFUEGOS' AND sync_status IN ('ACTIVE','REPLACED') AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(almacen_id)),'') IS NOT NULL), matches AS (SELECT a.SucursalID, COUNT_BIG(*) AS coincidencias FROM dbo.Inventario_Almacenes a INNER JOIN inv i ON LTRIM(RTRIM(a.CodigoAlmacen))=i.almacen_id AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.NombreAlmacen)))=i.almacen GROUP BY a.SucursalID), canonical AS (SELECT TOP (1) SucursalID, coincidencias FROM matches ORDER BY coincidencias DESC, SucursalID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync WHERE UPPER(unidad_negocio_codigo)='CIENFUEGOS') AS inventarios_total, (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM inv) AS almacenes_en_inventarios, ISNULL((SELECT coincidencias FROM canonical),0) AS almacenes_correspondientes, ISNULL((SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Inventario_Almacenes a INNER JOIN canonical c ON c.SucursalID=a.SucursalID WHERE a.Activo=1),0) AS almacenes_activos_catalogo
